verses.en: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.
verses.pt: Jacó habitava na terra das peregrinações de seu pai, na terra de Canaã.
verses.en_web: Jacob lived in the land of his father’s travels, in the land of Canaan.
verses.en_bbe: Now Jacob was living in the land where his father had made a place for himself, in the land of Canaan.

verses.en: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.
verses.pt: Estas são as gerações de Jacó. José, aos dezessete anos de idade, estava com seus irmãos apascentando os rebanhos; sendo ainda jovem, andava com os filhos de Bila, e com os filhos de Zilpa, mulheres de seu pai; e José trazia a seu pai más notícias a respeito deles.
verses.en_web: This is the history of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father.
verses.en_bbe: These are the generations of Jacob: Joseph, a boy seventeen years old, was looking after the flock, together with his brothers, the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father's wives; and Joseph gave their father a bad account of them.

verses.en: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.
verses.pt: Israel amava mais a José do que a todos os seus filhos, porque era filho da sua velhice; e fez-lhe uma túnica de várias cores.
verses.en_web: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a coat of many colors.
verses.en_bbe: Now the love which Israel had for Joseph was greater than his love for all his other children, because he got him when he was an old man: and he had a long coat made for him.

verses.en: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
verses.pt: Vendo, pois, seus irmãos que seu pai o amava mais do que a todos eles, odiavam-no, e não lhe podiam falar pacificamente.
verses.en_web: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.
verses.en_bbe: And because his brothers saw that Joseph was dearer to his father than all the others, they were full of hate for him, and would not say a kind word to him.

verses.en: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
verses.pt: José teve um sonho, que contou a seus irmãos; por isso o odiaram ainda mais.
verses.en_web: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.
verses.en_bbe: Now Joseph had a dream, and he gave his brothers an account of it, which made their hate greater than ever.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:
verses.pt: Pois ele lhes disse: Ouvi, peço-vos, este sonho que tive:
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Let me give you the story of my dream.

verses.en: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.
verses.pt: Estávamos nós atando molhos no campo, e eis que o meu molho, levantando-se, ficou em pé; e os vossos molhos o rodeavam, e se inclinavam ao meu molho.
verses.en_web: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves came around, and bowed down to my sheaf.”
verses.en_bbe: We were in the field, getting the grain stems together, and my grain kept upright, and yours came round and went down on the earth before mine.

verses.en: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.
verses.pt: Responderam-lhe seus irmãos: Tu pois, deveras reinarás sobre nós? Tu deveras terás domínio sobre nós? Por isso ainda mais o odiavam por causa dos seus sonhos e das suas palavras.
verses.en_web: His brothers said to him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Or will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.
verses.en_bbe: And his brothers said to him, Are you to be our king? will you have authority over us? And because of his dream and his words, their hate for him became greater than ever.

verses.en: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.
verses.pt: Teve José outro sonho, e o contou a seus irmãos, dizendo: Tive ainda outro sonho; e eis que o sol, e a lua, e onze estrelas se inclinavam perante mim.
verses.en_web: He dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brothers, and said, “Behold, I have dreamed yet another dream: and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.”
verses.en_bbe: Then he had another dream, and gave his brothers an account of it, saying, I have had another dream: the sun and the moon and eleven stars gave honour to me.

verses.en: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?
verses.pt: Quando o contou a seu pai e a seus irmãos, repreendeu-o seu pai, e disse-lhe: Que sonho é esse que tiveste? Porventura viremos, eu e tua mãe, e teus irmãos, a inclinar-nos com o rosto em terra diante de ti?
verses.en_web: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to you to the earth?”
verses.en_bbe: And he gave word of it to his father and his brothers; but his father protesting said, What sort of a dream is this? am I and your mother and your brothers to go down on our faces to the earth before you?

verses.en: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.
verses.pt: Seus irmãos, pois, o invejavam; mas seu pai guardava o caso no seu coração.
verses.en_web: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.
verses.en_bbe: And his brothers were full of envy; but his father kept his words in mind.

verses.en: And his brethren went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.
verses.pt: Ora, foram seus irmãos apascentar o rebanho de seu pai, em Siquém.
verses.en_web: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.
verses.en_bbe: Now his brothers went to keep watch over their father's flock in Shechem.

verses.en: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.
verses.pt: Disse, pois, Israel a José: Não apascentam teus irmãos o rebanho em Siquém? Vem, e enviar-te-ei a eles. Respondeu-lhe José: Eis-me aqui.
verses.en_web: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”
verses.en_bbe: And Israel said to Joseph, Are not your brothers with the flock in Shechem? come, I will send you to them. And he said to him, Here am I.

verses.en: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe Israel: Vai, vê se vão bem teus irmãos, e o rebanho; e traze-me resposta. Assim o enviou do vale de Hebrom; e José foi a Siquém.
verses.en_web: He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.” So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to him, Go now, and see if your brothers are well and how the flock is; then come back and give me word. So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

verses.en: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?
verses.pt: E um homem encontrou a José, que andava errante pelo campo, e perguntou-lhe: Que procuras?
verses.en_web: A certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field. The man asked him, “What are you looking for?”
verses.en_bbe: And a man saw him wandering in the country, and said to him, What are you looking for?

verses.en: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks.
verses.pt: Respondeu ele: Estou procurando meus irmãos; dize-me, peço-te, onde apascentam eles o rebanho.
verses.en_web: He said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, I am looking for my brothers; please give me word of where they are keeping their flock.

verses.en: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.
verses.pt: Disse o homem: Foram-se daqui; pois ouvi-lhes dizer: Vamos a Dotã. José, pois, seguiu seus irmãos, e os achou em Dotã.
verses.en_web: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let us go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.
verses.en_bbe: And the man said, They have gone away from here, for they said in my hearing, Let us go to Dothan. So Joseph went after them and came up with them at Dothan.

verses.en: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.
verses.pt: Eles o viram de longe e, antes que chegasse aonde estavam, conspiraram contra ele, para o matarem,
verses.en_web: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.
verses.en_bbe: But they saw him when he was a long way off, and before he came near them they made a secret design against him to put him to death;

verses.en: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.
verses.pt: dizendo uns aos outros: Eis que lá vem o sonhador!
verses.en_web: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.
verses.en_bbe: Saying to one another, See, here comes this dreamer.

verses.en: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.
verses.pt: Vinde pois agora, fmatemo-lo e lancemo-lo numa das covas; e diremos: uma besta-fera o devorou. Veremos, então, o que será dos seus sonhos.
verses.en_web: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has devoured him.’ We will see what will become of his dreams.”
verses.en_bbe: Let us now put him to death and put his body into one of these holes, and we will say, An evil beast has put him to death: then we will see what becomes of his dreams.

verses.en: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.
verses.pt: Mas Rúben, ouvindo isso, livrou-o das mãos deles, dizendo: Não lhe tiremos a vida.
verses.en_web: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”
verses.en_bbe: But Reuben, hearing these words, got him out of their hands, saying, Let us not take his life.

verses.en: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.
verses.pt: Também lhes disse Rúben: Não derrameis sangue; lançai-o nesta cova, que está no deserto, e não lanceis mão nele. Disse isto para livrá-lo das mãos deles, a fim de restituí-lo a seu pai.
verses.en_web: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.
verses.en_bbe: Do not put him to a violent death, but let him be placed in one of the holes; this he said to keep him safe from their hands, with the purpose of taking him back to his father again.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;
verses.pt: Logo que José chegou a seus irmãos, estes o despiram da sua túnica, a túnica de várias cores, que ele trazia;
verses.en_web: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped Joseph of his coat, the coat of many colors that was on him;
verses.en_bbe: So when Joseph came to his brothers, they took off his long coat which he had on;

verses.en: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.
verses.pt: e tomando-o, lançaram-no na cova; mas a cova estava vazia, não havia água nela.
verses.en_web: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.
verses.en_bbe: And they took him and put him in the hole: now the hole had no water in it.

verses.en: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
verses.pt: Depois sentaram-se para comer; e, levantando os olhos, viram uma caravana de ismaelitas que vinha de Gileade; nos seus camelos traziam tragacanto, bálsamo e mirra, que iam levar ao Egito.
verses.en_web: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites was coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: Then seating themselves, they took their meal: and looking up, they saw a travelling band of Ishmaelites, coming from Gilead on their way to Egypt, with spices and perfumes on their camels.

verses.en: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?
verses.pt: Disse Judá a seus irmãos: De que nos aproveita matar nosso irmão e encobrir o seu sangue?
verses.en_web: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?
verses.en_bbe: And Judah said to his brothers, What profit is there in putting our brother to death and covering up his blood?

verses.en: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.
verses.pt: Vinde, vendamo-lo a esses ismaelitas, e não seja nossa mão sobre ele; porque é nosso irmao, nossa carne. E escutaram-no seus irmãos.
verses.en_web: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.
verses.en_bbe: Let us give him to these Ishmaelites for a price, and let us not put violent hands on him, for he is our brother, our flesh. And his brothers gave ear to him.

verses.en: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.
verses.pt: Ao passarem os negociantes midianitas, tiraram José, alçando-o da cova, e venderam-no por vinte siclos de prata aos ismaelitas, os quais o levaram para o Egito.
verses.en_web: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. They brought Joseph into Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: And some traders from Midian went by; so pulling Joseph up out of the hole, they gave him to the Ishmaelites for twenty bits of silver, and they took him to Egypt.

verses.en: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.
verses.pt: Ora, Rúben voltou à cova, e eis que José não estava na cova; pelo que rasgou as suas vestes
verses.en_web: Reuben returned to the pit; and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.
verses.en_bbe: Now when Reuben came back to the hole, Joseph was not there; and giving signs of grief,

verses.en: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?
verses.pt: e, tornando a seus irmãos, disse: O menino não aparece; e eu, aonde irei?
verses.en_web: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”
verses.en_bbe: He went back to his brothers, and said, The child is gone; what am I to do?

verses.en: And they took Joseph’s coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;
verses.pt: Tomaram, então, a túnica de José, mataram um cabrito, e tingiram a túnica no sangue.
verses.en_web: They took Joseph’s coat, and killed a male goat, and dipped the coat in the blood.
verses.en_bbe: Then they took Joseph's coat, and put on it some of the blood from a young goat which they had put to death,

verses.en: And they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy son’s coat or no.
verses.pt: Enviaram a túnica de várias cores, mandando levá-la a seu pai e dizer-lhe: Achamos esta túnica; vê se é a túnica de teu filho, ou não.
verses.en_web: They took the coat of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it, now, whether it is your son’s coat or not.”
verses.en_bbe: And they took the coat to their father, and said, We came across this; is it your son's coat or not?

verses.en: And he knew it, and said, It is my son’s coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.
verses.pt: Ele a reconheceu e exclamou: A túnica de meu filho! uma besta-fera o devorou; certamente José foi despedaçado.
verses.en_web: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s coat. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”
verses.en_bbe: And he saw that it was, and said, It is my son's coat; an evil beast has put him to death; without doubt Joseph has come to a cruel end.

verses.en: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.
verses.pt: Então Jacó rasgou as suas vestes, e pôs saco sobre os seus lombos e lamentou seu filho por muitos dias.
verses.en_web: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jacob, giving signs of grief, put on haircloth, and went on weeping for his son day after day.

verses.en: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.
verses.pt: E levantaram-se todos os seus filhos e todas as suas filhas, para o consolarem; ele, porém, recusou ser consolado, e disse: Na verdade, com choro hei de descer para meu filho até o Seol. Assim o chorou seu pai.
verses.en_web: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol to my son mourning.” His father wept for him.
verses.en_bbe: And all his sons and all his daughters came to give him comfort, but he would not be comforted, saying with weeping, I will go down to the underworld to my son. So great was his father's sorrow for him.

verses.en: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, and captain of the guard.
verses.pt: Os midianitas venderam José no Egito a Potifar, oficial de Faraó, capitão da guarda.
verses.en_web: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.
verses.en_bbe: And in Egypt the men of Midian gave him for a price to Potiphar, a captain of high position in Pharaoh's house.
